aboutpara: I combine central banking expertise with technical skills to analyze policy transmission, market dynamics, and investment opportunities. My background spans ECB prudential supervision, rates and collateral frameworks, and market operations. I build web applications, automation tools, and AI-assisted research pipelines to enhance analytical workflows. Currently focused on bridging policy analysis with quantitative investment research.
